resources.string: Who this phone can be. Each profile is its own key with its own contacts — the shop never learns your friends, and your friends never meet the shop. New relationships join whichever profile you are wearing.
What this side of you is called — Shop, Market, Browsing.
Four is the limit: profiles only work when they fit on one hand.
A profile cannot be deleted — its contacts answer to its key alone. Stop using it and it goes quiet.
Showing %1$s’s contacts — switch profiles in the drawer for the rest.
